summary: Draft updated at submission.json (validated read-only: valid, no diagnostics). With the run's budget expiring at the end of this turn, this last step is source-only contrast material rather than a new execution, and it claims no investigation, interpretation or experiment because neither entry reports an observed instance. Entry one records that the proposal path does signal one class of drop with an error: increaseUncommittedSize refuses a non-empty payload that would push the uncommitted tail over MaxUncommittedEntriesSize (raft.go:2094-2111), appendEntry logs a warning and returns false (raft.go:815-829), and stepLeader turns that into ErrProposalDropped for the caller (raft.go:1341-1343) - which gives the reviewer a clean-rejection datum to weigh against the silently substituted conf-change entry recorded earlier. Entry two records the Node layer's silent nil: Node.Step returns nil for a local message type arriving from a non-local From, with the code comment asking whether an error should be returned (node.go:478-483), the same layer whose proposal call was measured to signal only the caller's deadline after the node applied its own removal. Across the run the record now holds nine answered questions with retained receipts and explicit counterevidence: three ReadIndex results (rctx-coalescing starvation, its stale-index child, and the deferred-request release that holds), two payload-abort findings (empty-Entries read-index and undecodable conf-change proposals, including the unvalidated follower relay), the silent conf-change replacement and the last-voter apply abort, the removed-leader progress stall with its step-down control, external-trigger boundary and varied-schedule reproduction, and the Node API's deadline-only signal, plus the response-shape validation as a source-explained negative and this final sourced contrast; no experiment is left uninterpreted, and defect validity, CFT relevance and deduplication remain with human offline review.
